doc.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

chapter: Papa Jo Jones and the Sweet Baby Blues Band
title: Jimmy Noone and the Library of Congress films
summary: MR asks whether the band's Jimmy Noone was the Chicago Jimmy Noone's son; they mention the Library of Congress induction.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Speaking of fathers and sons, was the Jimmy Noone that played with you, was he the son of the Chicago Jimmy?
Jimmy Noone out of New Orleans.
Because when I first saw that on the record, I said, wait a minute — I had to go to my encyclopedia because that’s so cool.
I think one of the videos, was the last thing that he played on, Jimmy Noone.
That’s the one where he did the club date, right?
That’s right. That’s the one that they put into the Library of Congress.
Yeah, we got inducted into the Library of Congress. That, and also the “Three Generations of Blues.” Both of those are in.
